label: Trade & Craft
description: People who make physical things, described by the marks the work leaves on them. Measured gap: of 35 trades enumerated from the world the library answered 7. human/archetype covers roles you can recognise across a room; this covers hands that have done something for twenty years.

items.name: blacksmith
items.text: a blacksmith at the forge, leather apron scorched through in places, forearms corded and marked with old spark burns, soot in every crease of the knuckles
items.text_short: blacksmith in a scorched leather apron, spark-burned forearms

items.name: farrier
items.text: a farrier bent over a hoof cradled between the knees, chaps worn shiny at the thigh, nails held in the lips and a rasp in the free hand
items.text_short: farrier with a hoof between the knees, nails held in the lips

items.name: welder
items.text: a welder mid-bead, flip-front helmet down, spatter freckling the sleeves and a blue afterglow still on the seam
items.text_short: welder mid-bead, helmet down and spatter on the sleeves

items.name: carpenter
items.text: a carpenter with a pencil behind the ear and shavings caught in the turn-ups, a rule in the apron pocket and thumbs squared off from decades of chisels
items.text_short: carpenter with a pencil behind the ear and shavings in the turn-ups

items.name: wood-carver
items.text: a wood carver working a gouge with both hands, chips banking around the boots, grain dust settled into the eyebrows
items.text_short: wood carver two-handed on a gouge, chips banked at the boots

items.name: cooper
items.text: a cooper setting staves inside a barrel hoop, mallet in one fist, sleeves rolled past the elbow and oak dust standing in the light
items.text_short: cooper setting staves, mallet in one fist

items.name: luthier
items.text: a luthier holding a half-built body to the light, glue drying on the fingertips, spruce shavings curled across the bench behind
items.text_short: luthier sighting a half-built body against the light

items.name: potter
items.text: a potter at the wheel, clay slip to the elbows and drying pale on the forearms, wet thumbs opening a cylinder from the centre
items.text_short: potter at the wheel, slip drying pale on the forearms

items.name: glassblower
items.text: a glassblower shaping blown glass on the pipe, face lit orange from the glory hole, one arm shielding against heat while the other keeps the rotation even
items.text_short: glassblower shaping blown glass at the glory hole

items.name: stonemason
items.text: a stonemason with a bolster and lump hammer, white dust settled into the hair and the seams of the jacket, cut stone squared up behind
items.text_short: stonemason under white dust, bolster and lump hammer

items.name: weaver
items.text: a weaver at a floor loom, feet on the treadles and shuttle mid-throw, warp threads drawn taut into the distance
items.text_short: weaver at a floor loom, shuttle mid-throw

items.name: tailor
items.text: a tailor with a tape around the neck and pins held between the lips, chalk marks down a half-made sleeve laid across the arm
items.text_short: tailor with pins in the lips and chalk on a half-made sleeve

items.name: cobbler
items.text: a cobbler on a low stool with a last between the knees, tacks in a tin lid, hands blackened to the nail beds with wax and dye
items.text_short: cobbler with a last between the knees, wax-blackened hands

items.name: leatherworker
items.text: a leatherworker burnishing an edge, awl and waxed thread laid out in order, hide draped over one shoulder and a stitching pony gripped between the thighs
items.text_short: leatherworker burnishing an edge over a stitching pony

items.name: upholsterer
items.text: an upholsterer with a magnetic hammer and a mouth of tacks, webbing stretched across a stripped frame and horsehair spilling from an old seat
items.text_short: upholsterer, tacks in the mouth and webbing stretched taut

items.name: bookbinder
items.text: a bookbinder paring leather to a whisper at the edge, bone folder in reach, presses standing loaded along the wall behind
items.text_short: bookbinder paring leather thin, bone folder in reach

items.name: printer
items.text: a printer inking a forme by hand, fingertips permanently grey, type cases open and a proof still tacky on the stone
items.text_short: printer inking a forme, fingertips permanently grey

items.name: watchmaker
items.text: a watchmaker with a loupe screwed into the eye socket, tweezers steady over a movement no bigger than a coin, breath deliberately shallow

items.name: jeweller
items.text: a jeweller at the bench peg, torch in one hand and a ring shank in the other, a leather catch-skin slung underneath for the filings
items.text_short: jeweller at the bench peg, torch and ring shank

items.name: baker
items.text: a baker sliding a peel into the oven mouth, flour to the elbows and worked into the apron, forearms marked with old rack burns
items.text_short: baker at the oven mouth, flour to the elbows

items.name: butcher
items.text: a butcher breaking a side down, chainmail glove on the guiding hand, striped apron and a steel swinging at the hip

items.name: vintner

items.text_short: vintner drawing a barrel sample by pipette

items.name: beekeeper

items.name: shepherd

items.name: roofer

items.name: plumber
items.text: a plumber on one knee under a sink, wrench set out in size order, PTFE tape looped over a finger and a torch clamped in the teeth

items.name: florist
items.text: a florist stripping thorns with a blade drawn toward the thumb, stems banked in buckets, offcuts deep across the bench

items.text: a gardener kneeling with soil worked past the wrists, a fork stood upright in the bed and twine looped through a belt loop
items.text_short: gardener with soil past the wrists, fork stood in the bed

items.name: basket-maker
